## 1. Inheritance exception on and off

On: published rule-driven view (59 unexplained DIFF cells whose inputs agree only modulo row order or index count as inherited). Off: the pure criterion (introduced iff the cell's class is coarser than the finest level at which all its inputs agree). Unaffected: shares by class (all scored cells), the clean@E0, clean@E2 and clean@E3 views, every paired comparison, first divergence, notebooks without an engine-side failure and introduced error cells (the exception applies to DIFF cells only): all use classes and clean levels, not kinds.

Taxonomy totals (7 configurations on 102 notebooks plus the pilot's bodo_dw): introduced 2147 on, 2206 off; assigned by rules or the curated table 2030 (both); unattributed by the rules 117 on, 176 off; exception cells 59 (bodo 14, bodo_dw 1, dask 3, fireducks 13, modin 6, p15 15, p30 2, pyarrow_backend 5).

## 4. Classification order and cause rules

1 NONDET (reference runs disagree): nondeterminism, excluded
2 an engine against its own replicate: nondeterminism (UNCOMPARABLE: harness)
3 MEMORY or NOTRUN: cascade (engine stop)
4 ERR with NameError or UnboundLocalError: cascade (undefined name)
5 UNCOMPARABLE: harness
6 class not coarser than the clean level: inherited (propagated)
7 curated table (21 cells): introduced, curated cause
8 cause rules in order, first match wins: introduced, rule cause
9 EXCEPTION (enabled in every published count): no curated entry and no rule matched, class DIFF, clean level E1 or E4: inherited (cause order_propagated)
10 otherwise: introduced, unattributed
